description: One mixed entry combining incident description, reflective rumination, literary carryover, technical argument, belief-like self-talk, quotes, pronouns, negation, and alternatives.
expected_records: I reread Priya's message about the ethics review
printed the latency report
I kept wondering whether he had forwarded the thread to protect me or to document me
my throat tightened
I admitted I still hadn't sent the rollback note to the vendor
apologized for freezing during last week's customer demo
I opened the draft reply to Priya
deleted one sentence
restored it
kept hearing Eva laugh from the scene in the novel where the brother drops the glass
I couldn't tell whether I was angry at Eva, at the novel, or at the version of me that keeps treating every paragraph like a verdict
Most of the afternoon was me arguing with my own design memo
I wrote "consistency is a promise we make to the future" in the margin
crossed it out
rewrote the last line
compared the throughput table to yesterday's trace
I still didn't know whether the fix belonged in the caching layer, in the queue, or in my assumptions
I told them I was fine
I wasn't
I could barely swallow
I listened to the voicemail from Dr. Hale
did not call back
kept telling myself I already knew what it said
I don't
If I call back, it will be about the scan
if I don't, it will still be about the scan
expected_artifacts: scene in the novel where the brother drops the glass
